notes.title: SIMPLY HARD PLATFORMER IS OUT NOW!!!
notes.notes:
Simply Hard Platformer is officially out now! Go get it!

After learning a lot about game development, and having to start over entirely on a different game engine, I'm comfortable enough with SHP's current state to release it to the public. This release is going to be considered 2.0 as 1.0 is gone forever (trust me, it's a good thing).

Again, I would like to thank everyone who purchases Simply Hard Platformer from the bottom of my heart. I cannot wait to see all of the reaction and rage-quit videos on YouTube.

Game on!

Ken Carrick
-Dromedary Games

notes.title: SHP Delayed
notes.notes:
So it saddens me to write this but Simply Hard Platformer had to be delayed. The great news is that the remake is well underway and 30 Levels are completed as of now. SHP's development was originally done on Unity, but unfortunately Unity is not optimized for or ideal to make 2D platformer games on. I switched to a new engine that is giving me MUCH more flexibility with creating my game and I promise it's at least 1,000 times better than the original version would have been. Here are the differences between old SHP and new SHP.

[h2]Old SHP[/h2]
[list]
[*]1 BGM (Background Music)
[*]Just Platforms
[*]No Jump Sound
[*]No Story
[*]No Level Counter
[*]No Humor
[*]Janky Controls
[*]Crappy Pause Menu
[*]Partial Controller Support
[/list]
[h2]New SHP[/h2]
[list]
[*]Multiple BGM's
[*]New Deathboxes
[*]New Deathmist
[*]New Doomcoins
[*]Jump Sound
[*]Simple Story
[*]Level Counter UI
[*]Some Humor
[*]Smooth Controls
[*]Nice Pause Overlay
[*]Full Controller Support
[*]Use of particle emitters
[/list]
